name: plures
description: Human in the loop for AI agents: ask ID verified people to check a decision before your agent acts. Adds the Plures skill and the plures-mcp server (ask_humans).

interface.shortDescription: Ask verified people before your agent acts
interface.longDescription: Plures sends a decision your agent isn't sure about to ID verified people and returns their consensus, or routes it to your own team. The skill teaches Codex when to add a human check and how to wire it in; the MCP server gives it an ask_humans tool. Set PLURES_API_KEY first: a free pk_test_ key from plures.si answers instantly without reaching real people.
defaultPrompt: Add a human check before refunds go out
Ask verified people whether this customer message sounds upset
